_comment: How many glomeruli each Kenyon cell listens to, measured from MaleCNS v1.0 and reduced to a histogram. Derived from a CC-BY dataset; see reports/licenses.md for the attribution this carries. Cells with zero claws are excluded - in the measured circuit they are cells that take no input from these glomeruli, not cells wired to nothing, and resampling them would silently shrink the tag space.
attribution: FlyEM Project Team (HHMI Janelia); University of Cambridge, Dept. of Zoology; MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology; Google Research
derivation: Summary statistic derived from the MaleCNS v1.0 flat-connectome tables: the number of distinct glomeruli presynaptic to each Kenyon cell, reduced to a histogram. The wiring cannot be reconstructed from it. Regenerate with bench/benchmark_claw_degrees.py's source circuit, extracted by flypaper.brain.extract.
source: MaleCNS v1.0, right hemisphere olfactory circuit
